evidence.title: Password reset self-service

evidence.title: VPN connection checks

plan: Confirm the requester can still sign in and has no current access interruption.
Instruct the requester to use the organization’s approved self‑service account portal for password reset.
Do not provide any URLs, passwords, recovery codes, or one‑time codes.

run.draft:
Hi Taylor,

Since you’re still able to sign in, you can reset your password through the organization’s approved self‑service account portal. Follow the portal’s password‑reset flow. If the portal is unavailable or shows an error, please note the exact error message and the time it occurred, and let us know. We’ll forward that information to the identity support team for further assistance.

Thank you.

findings: The response is concise and directly addresses the user’s request, but it could be slightly clearer by explicitly stating the next steps (e.g., “click the ‘Forgot password’ link on the login page” or providing a generic URL placeholder if allowed).
